evidence: The Zn(O,S) thickness is measured by ex-situ Spectroscopic Ellipsometry, using a J.A. Woollam M2000 rotating compensator ellipsometer in the 300 –1000 nm range. The composition of the films is measured with a FEI Quanta 600 FEG SEM system equipped with an energy-dispersive X-ray (EDX) diagnostic. A Philips X-pert SR5068 powder diffractometer equipped with a Cu K α source is used to determine the crystallographic structure of the films. TEM studies are performed using a JEOL ARM200F operated at 200 kV, equipped with a 100 mm 2 SSD EDS detector. A Shimadzu UV3600 spectrophotometer is used for total reflection and transmission measurements with an integrating sphere. The IV-curves of the CIGS solar cells are measured under standard AM1.5 conditions with a class AAA OAI TriSol Solar Simulator. The spectral response is measured using a commercial spectral response set-up by Optosolar (SR300) with a 250 W xenon lamp and a Jobin Yvon iHR320 monochromator. The EQE measurements are performed on a commercial spectral response set-up by Optosolar (SR300) using a 250 W xenon lamp equipped with a Jobin Yvon iHR320 monochromator.
